method: Read rendered SharePoint pages and inventories using the signed-in browser. No hidden APIs, cookies, or authentication tokens were exported.

Anchor, Passive, and Active Program List links all reported removed or unavailable in the current Box session.
Historical August calendar entries were not exported; the displayed October week had zero events.

raw browser captures and account identity
